title: We Dont Need Another Hero

WE ARE THE CHILDREN
THE LAST GENERATION

LIVING UNDER THE FEAR,
TILL NOTHING ELSE REMAINS
WE DON`T NEED ANOTHER HERO

ALL WE WANT IS LIFE BEYOND
THUNDERDOME

ALL WE WANT IS LIFE BEYOND
